judge.rationale: The candidate stopped after writing a definition-of-done file, the initial spec draft, and failing acceptance tests without actually implementing any of the functionality. `src/orchestration/tools/registry.ts` is completely untouched, `ajv` was not added to `package.json`, and none of the documentation, changelog, or unit test files (`registry.test.ts`, `chatOrchestrator.test.ts`, `README.md`, `docs/adding-a-tool.md`, `.specify/spec.md`) were updated. Because the added acceptance tests assert on validation behavior that does not exist yet, the test suite will fail immediately. While the spec and test structure align well with the ticket's requirements, the implementation itself is completely missing.
